thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: P0 - high-rate crashloops observed for runtime pods in pool `dedicated-gpu-3`. Alert: 30% of engine pods restarting in last 5m with SIGSEGV. Affected service: /v1/generate (redwood-runtime). Runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/rb-runtime-crashloop>
jordan (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Pulling pod logs now. Did we just roll an engine image earlier? :rotating_light:
priya: I see a deploy for `engine:v1.5.0-trt` at 2026-03-15T00:45Z in prod-dedicated. Samir, any context on that release?
samir: That was the TRT fused-kernel rollout for lower p99 latency. Can confirm it's v1.5.0. We did a small canary earlier. No alerts then.
cody: kubectl describe shows CrashLoopBackOff + `Signal 11 (SIGSEGV)` in container state. Recent kernel logs show `GPU 0: illegal memory access` for a couple hosts.
jordan (oncall): grabbing `kubectl logs -p` from one of the failing pods — snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T01:02:07Z] runtime: launching model q4_0 in engine
[2026-03-15T01:02:07Z] engine: loading TRT module fused_attention.cu: build_id=0x7a3e
[2026-03-15T01:02:08Z] ERROR runtime: kernel crash: SIGSEGV at 0x7ff
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what(): CUDA error: an illegal memory access was encountered
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
megan: also saw a couple OOMKilled events right before segfaults on node `ded-gpu-03` — possible memory corruption leading to illegal mem access.
ops-bot: Event: Node `ded-gpu-03` experienced a short GPU driver reset and kubelet restarted containers (node-flap). Pod eviction count increased by 7.
priya: Customer impact check: internal telemetry shows 5xx spikes on generation endpoints between 01:01 and 01:12 UTC. Approx 12 customers affected with retries causing elevated latencies. No billing anomalies detected so far.
jordan (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Scale down engine deployment to 0 replicas on pool `dedicated-gpu-3` to stop crash churn. 2) Roll back to engine:v1.4.2 (last stable). 3) Disable TRT fused kernel via env `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1` as hotfix if rollback fails. 4) Cordon the suspect node and run diagnostics for GPU errors. Starting step 1 now.
samir: Agreed. I'm preparing a rollback manifest. If we rollback, we should also disable the canary routing for v1.5.0 across dedicated pools.
cody: Executed `kubectl scale deploy/redwood-engine --replicas=0 -n prod-dedicated` and drained crash churn. Watching events.
ops-bot: Notification: Deployment scaled to 0 replicas. Crash churn stopped on pool `dedicated-gpu-3`.
jordan (oncall): Initiating rollback to `engine:v1.4.2` and will start with a single replica in `dedicated-gpu-1` to validate. Rolling out now.
eng-runtime: Heads-up — v1.5.0 introduced a fused kernel change in `fused_attention.cu` that had limited unit coverage for edge sequence lengths > 8k. We're looking into a repro harness.
megan: While rollback in progress, I'm running `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,gpu_uuid,used_memory --format=csv` and collecting `dmesg` plus `journalctl -u kubelet` for the node that flapped.
priya: Notifying account team for impacted customers and updating status page: brief incident note up now. No PII exposed; no data plane reads.
samir: Rollback to v1.4.2 started. Creating image tag rollback job: `kubectl set image deploy/redwood-engine=redwood/engine:v1.4.2`.
jordan (oncall): After rollback, spinning to 3 replicas in non-affected pools to absorb traffic. Observability: error rate dropping — p95 latency returning to normal. Keeping one engineer on node diagnostics.
cody: Post-rollback logs from new pods show healthy startup. No SIGSEGVs for 4m now.
eng-runtime: We reproduced a minimal segfault locally with synthetic seq length 12000 and TRT fused kernel enabled. Crash reproduces under heavy contiguous allocation pattern. Adding to the repro tracker.
megan: Collected core from failing pod and uploaded to artifact store: <https://artifacts.internal/core-2245006789.tar.gz>. Stack shows crash in `fused_attention::dispatch` -> `cudaMemcpyAsync` -> illegal mem access.
priya: Customer impact summary for pager: ~12 customers experienced 500s, highest concentrated on real-time chat generation. Mean time to error was ~3s, retries mitigated some calls. No long-term data loss. SLAs: transient SLO miss for 01:01–01:12 UTC, engineering to quantify exact error budget use.
jordan (oncall): Temporary mitigation validated. Next: eng-runtime to produce patch to disable unsafe allocation path in fused kernel and add additional unit tests covering long sequences. Also add a deployment gate preventing fused kernel rollout without extended integration tests.
samir: I'll open PR to revert the fused kernel commit. If patch is small, we can hotfix v1.5.0 with `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1` and push a v1.5.1 quickfix.
cody: Node `ded-gpu-03` remains cordoned and is under hardware / driver investigation. No new pods scheduled to it.
ops-bot: Action required: Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime. Pager escalation window ends in 2h. Please update incident timeline in the incident tracker.
jordan (oncall): handoff -> samir (next oncall) in 10m. Summary for handoff: root cause likely fused TRT kernel illegal mem write under long seqs; immediate rollback done to v1.4.2; cordoned node; artifacts collected; patch + revert in flight; customer impact low-medium (~12 customers, short window). All logs, cores and repro attached.
samir: taking over. I'll validate the rollback stability for next hour, coordinate with eng-runtime for patch, and start the postmortem doc.
megan: leaving notes in the runbook: add step to `kubectl logs -p` for SIGSEGV and automated env var toggles to disable fused kernels during rollouts.
jordan (oncall): Thanks team. If you need me, ping DM. Going offline for handoff. :thumbsup:
priya: Thanks — updating status page to reflect mitigation and ETA for resolution. Will escalate if errors recur.
eng-runtime: We'll add CI test cases and a canary checker for sequence-length distributions. ETA for patch PR: 4 hours. Will coordinate a safe re-roll after tests.
samir: Confirmed stable for now. Documenting next steps and assigning owners in the postmortem. Closing pager for this wave.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Please file follow-ups: 1) Revert/fix fused kernel, 2) Add sequence-length CI, 3) Better node recovery automations.
megan: Logged action items in the postmortem tracker: PM/SE to notify impacted accounts with incident summary.
samir: I'll draft the postmortem and include timeline + diffs for v1.5.0. Assigning eng-runtime and QA for verification before any future fused-kernel rollout.
